findings.title: Direct LLM API calls bypass model router in emergency alert processing

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral via environment API keys rather than querying router endpoint

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM synthesis requests through the model router service at port 8891 rather than calling third-party provider SDKs directly.

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes rate limiting, failover routing, cost monitoring, and telemetry through the model router.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: router_bypass; Evidence strength: strong; Confidence: 0.85; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_more_evidence; Reason: Evidence insufficient (need conclusive); Category reason: Router bypasses must be corrected by design review
